# Justin Grant, UX Designer and Researcher

> UX designer and researcher for complex SaaS, open-source, and e-commerce products, focused on data governance, payments, and workflows that cross many teams. Ten years across enterprise tech, education, HR, and open-source AI. Research at every stage: generative, formative, and summative.

Website: https://justingrant.design/
Contact: justin@justingrant.design
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/justgrant5/

## Case studies
- [Mozilla Data Collective: designing the next phase of an ethical data platform](https://justingrant.design/mdc.html): site architecture, data access controls, data quality signals, services marketplace, pricing market research across 200+ datasets, and a demand survey with a false door. Platform: 600+ datasets, 190+ vetted organizations, 300+ languages.
- [Mozilla Common Voice: fixing bad voice data before it's recorded](https://justingrant.design/common-voice.html): Spontaneous Speech, a 0-to-1 product for unscripted speech. Shipped in 58 languages; 62 language datasets in release 2.0.
- [hrsimple.com: making employment law readable, and worth paying for](https://justingrant.design/hrsimple.html): eight years as sole designer and developer. 10,000 paying clients; staff workload cut 75 percent; B2B pipeline doubled to $1.6M.
